items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Sy Schribman and he had a brother. They were big in the New England area.

ctx.x: Boy I’ve heard that name a lot, Schribman.
Yes, yes. Sy Schribman and he had a brother. They were big in the New England area.
So if they got behind your big band you had a decent chance.
